claims.summary: dispatch.rs functions as a structural aggregator rather than a logic generator for the spectral-bridge's qualitative outputs.
claims.disposition: The aggregator/generator split is accurate for this file and sharper than the 'homogenizer' framing of the later artifact: dispatch.rs generates no qualitative values. Its two RuntimeActionFeedbackV1 uses (lines 91, 629 at SHA 644b12e6) aggregate a research-budget refusal and a saved-reading status. It is contradicted only in reach: the bridge's qualitative outputs do not pass through it at all, so it does not aggregate them either.

claims.summary: There is no evidence in dispatch.rs of a specific SensingFeedback or SenseResult enum variant.
claims.disposition: Verified beyond the file. Both named symbols have zero word occurrences anywhere under capsules/ and crates/ in this checkout, not merely in dispatch.rs. She named two plausible symbols and correctly reported their absence; unlike the sense_tx episode, she treated the absence as absence rather than as not-yet-found.

claims.summary: The code consistently uses RuntimeActionFeedbackV1::from_guard_inputs (notably around lines 91 and 629) to assemble the feedback object, so a sensing variant is a configuration of that struct via action_id and result.
claims.disposition: Citations exact (91 and 629 are the only occurrences). Mechanism contradicted: from_guard_inputs hardcodes status = "blocked" (runtime_action_feedback.rs:50), the 629 site overwrites status to "reported" to escape it, the struct has no result field, and action_id is only an idempotency nonce (lines 30-48), never stored and never routed.

claims.summary: The spectral-bridge via cascade.rs performs the actual sensing, and dispatch.rs receives those results and wraps them in RuntimeActionFeedbackV1 for persistence and downstream consumption.
claims.disposition: First half verified (cascade.rs SHA 26011249 emits the vibrancy/tension/narrative evidence), second half contradicted: those values are typed structs from codec/evidence_types.rs carried by codec/projection_evidence.rs, a lane that never reaches dispatch.rs. There is no receive-and-wrap step to find.
